claim.claim-text: 1. A catheter system, comprising: a catheter assembly, comprising:

2. The catheter system of claim 1, wherein the needle hub further comprises a pocket, wherein the proximal end of the needle is disposed within the pocket, wherein the pocket is proximate the first hole.

3. The catheter system of claim 1, wherein the middle barrel comprises a channel, wherein the channel is formed by a plurality of side walls that extend from a bottom of the channel to the inner surface of the outer barrel and contact the inner surface of the outer barrel.
4. The catheter system of claim 1, wherein the inner barrel and the needle hub are configured to move proximally within the middle barrel to retract the needle.

5. The catheter system of claim 4, wherein the needle assembly comprises a button and a spring, wherein the inner barrel and the needle hub move proximally in response to depression of the button and actuation of the spring.
